name: SSHT S&T Group Ltd.
summary: SSHT S&T Group Ltd. specializes in developing and distributing digital mobile data terminals and their accompanying software solutions, designed for comprehensive vehicle management. A dedicated subsidiary oversees the entire process for their equipment, from its conception and manufacturing to market sales. Central to their offerings is an adaptable and programmable Mobile Data Terminal (MDT), which functions as a vehicle tracking and GPS location system. This MDT integrates smoothly with clients' existing two-way radio networks, providing vital vehicle status information and resolving various operational issues for vehicle fleets. The company further designs and sells proprietary software, intended for installation on a customer's central office Windows-based PC. This software translates digital data received from vehicle fleets, acts as a central communication hub, and renders real-time mapping of vehicle locations. All data exchanged via this proprietary software is archived on the PC for future reference and documentation. Founded in 1984 as Wireless Data Solutions, Inc., the company later rebranded to SSHT S&T Group Ltd. and is headquartered in St. Cloud, Minnesota.
